article.story: FAIRFAX, Va. -- — Brayden O’Connor had 16 points in George Mason’s 83-60 victory against North Carolina Central on Wednesday. O’Connor shot 7 for 11, including 1 for 3 from beyond the arc for the Patriots (4-1). Emmanuel Kanga added 15 points while shooting 5 of 8 from the field and 5 for 8 from the line while they also had 13 rebounds. Baraka Okojie had 11 points and went 3 of 7 from the field (3 for 4 from 3-point range). Ryan Archey led the way for the Eagles (1-5) with 19 points and two steals. Cristian Sanon added 12 points for North Carolina Central. Trey Brown finished with eight points. George Mason took the lead for good with 18:13 remaining in the first half. The score was 48-28 at halftime, with Okojie racking up eight points. George Mason pulled away with a 16-3 run in the second half to extend a 14-point lead to 27 points. They outscored North Carolina Central by three points in the final half, as O’Connor led the way with a team-high 10 second-half points. Up next Up next for George Mason is a Saturday matchup with South Florida at home, and North Carolina Central hosts Carolina University on Monday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
